name: Jehoiada
description: High Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: In the seventh year Jehoiada the priest brought the rulers over hundreds into the house of the Lord, made a covenant with them, showed them the king's son, and set armed guards around him on every side: and he that cometh within the ranges, let him be slain.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: In the seventh year Jehoiada the priest brought the captains together, took an oath of them in the house of the Most High, and showed them the king's son.

note.label: 2 Kings 11: The Hidden King and the Covenant to Be the Lord's People

points: The captains did according to all that Jehoiada commanded, taking their men to the priest.

note.label: 2 Kings 11: The Hidden King and the Covenant to Be the Lord's People

points: Jehoiada the priest commanded, Have her forth without the ranges, and him that followeth her kill with the sword; let her not be slain in the house of the Lord. And they laid hands on her, and by the way the horses came into the king's house, there was she slain. That was the restoring of order: twice in the history, when wicked women rose up in power to devour, God sent men of the Lord to remove them for not listening to what God got to say.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Jehoiada made a covenant between the Most High, the king, and the people, that they should be the Lord's people.

note.label: 2 Kings 11: The Hidden King and the Covenant to Be the Lord's People

points: He did that which was right in the sight of the Most High all the days that Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

note.label: 2 Kings 12: Repairing the House and Dealing Faithfully

points: Jehoash called Jehoiada and the priests, asked why the house was not repaired, and directed that the money no longer be received by them but delivered directly for the repairs.

note.label: 2 Kings 12: Repairing the House and Dealing Faithfully

points: Jehoiada took a chest, bored a hole in the lid, and set it beside the altar, and the priests put in all the money brought to the house.

note.label: 2 Kings 12: Repairing the House and Dealing Faithfully

points: But Jehoshabeath the daughter of king Jehoram, wife of Jehoiada the priest and sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, hiding him and his nurse in a bedchamber.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah and the Rise of Athaliah

points: In the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself and took the captains of hundreds into covenant with him, and they gathered the Levites and the chief of the fathers out of all the cities of Judah to Jerusalem.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: The Levites and all Judah did according to all Jehoiada commanded, each man keeping his company, for Jehoiada did not dismiss the courses of the Levites but kept them at their work with security added for the king.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: Jehoiada delivered to the captains the spears and shields that had been king David's, kept in the house of God, and set every man with his weapon from one side of the temple to the other, round about the king.
This was done by the proper custom: a priest anoints the king, as Samuel the priest anointed Saul and then David; so Jehoiada the priest anointed Joash.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: They brought out the king's son, put the crown upon him, gave him the testimony, and made him king, and Jehoiada and his sons anointed him and said, God save the king.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: Jehoiada commanded the captains to have her forth from the ranges and to slay any that followed her, but not to slay her in the house of the Most High.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: Jehoiada appointed the officers of the house of the Most High by the hand of the priests and Levites whom David had distributed, to offer burnt offerings with rejoicing and singing as ordained by David.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: Joash did that which was right in the sight of the Most High all the days of Jehoiada the priest, because that is what he was taught.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 24: Joash Repairs the House and Then Falls

points: The Levites did not hasten it, so the king called Jehoiada the chief and asked why he had not required of the Levites the collection appointed by Moses for the tabernacle of witness.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 24: Joash Repairs the House and Then Falls

points: The workmen perfected the work and set the house of God in its state, then brought the rest of the money to make vessels of gold and silver to minister and offer with, and they offered burnt offerings continually all the days of Jehoiada.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 24: Joash Repairs the House and Then Falls

points: Jehoiada waxed old and was full of days and died, being a hundred and thirty years old at his death.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 24: Joash Repairs the House and Then Falls

points: After the death of Jehoiada the princes of Judah came and made obeisance to the king, and the king hearkened to them.

As soon as Jehoiada died, Israel went off again, because the king was weak and started listening to those who served other gods; this teaches the lesson that lust drives Israel to idolatry, and that the Most High will always send prophets to warn them.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 24: Joash Repairs the House and Then Falls

points: The spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, who stood above the people and asked why they transgressed the commandments so that they could not prosper, telling them that because they had forsaken the Most High, He had also forsaken them.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 24: Joash Repairs the House and Then Falls

points: They left Joash in great diseases, and his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada and slew him on his bed, and he was buried in the city of David but not in the sepulchres of the kings.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 24: Joash Repairs the House and Then Falls

points: Upon them comes all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias.

cases.name: Jehoiada the priest
cases.charge: Hiding the king’s son in the house of God six years; crowning him with the testimony; making a covenant that they should be the Lord’s people; doing good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house
cases.preview: When Athaliah destroyed the seed royal, Jehoshabeath the wife of Jehoiada the priest stole the infant Joash and hid him in the house of God six years (2 Chronicles 22:10-12).
